name: Oakhaven Forge
description: Ralph's blacksmith shop. The steady clang of hammer on iron echoes through the heavy heat of the forge.
visualTheme: A hot, soot-covered stone workshop with a massive glowing hearth, racks of steel weapons, and a heavy iron anvil.

history.createdWhy: Built to support the local logging industry and supply guards with weapons.
history.builtWho: Founded by Ralph, a master smith from the capital.
history.majorEvents: Smelted the iron ore that reinforced the Oakhaven stockade.
history.whyExists: Provides tools, weapons, and armor repair for the entire foothill settlement.
history.currentConflicts: Supply lines of quality coal have been disrupted by goblin activity.

npcs.name: Ralph the Smith
dialogue: You call that a weapon? It's more toothpick than iron.
Bring me copper ore and birch wood, and we'll forge you something real.
Keep your equipment repaired. A broken shield is a death sentence.
